refill.why: In the Welsh, 'wythnos yn ôl' could belong to 'met' or to 'said', but the Korean ties it only to 말한. The sentence is also long and clumsy for a USE phrase.
The Welsh has no question mark, so 'wnest ti wylio…' could be a statement or a question. The Korean asks a question, so the learner cannot tell which one is meant.
